description: Say what a single cosmetic ingredient does in a moisturizer (humectant, emollient, occlusive, preservative and so on), its typical use level, common alternative names, and any notes for sensitive skin. Covers 233 common moisturizer ingredients by INCI or common name, and makes a labeled best guess from the name for anything else.

name.description: Ingredient name, INCI or common, e.g. 'Butyrospermum Parkii Butter' or 'shea butter'.

title: Explain one skincare ingredient
